suggestion.topic: Python GIL Explained: Why Multi-Threading Fails You
suggestion.rationale: Python developers continuously hit CPU-bound performance bottlenecks and are baffled when threading doesn't utilize multi-core processors. Explaining the Global Interpreter Lock cleanly captures massive search volume and long-tail retention.
suggestion.hook_angle: Why does adding more threads to your Python script actually make it run slower? Let's expose the Global Interpreter Lock.
